_comment: EXT-17 M5 - the committed example sweep. CR-PAR-1 and CR-PAR-2.
One axis, declared here rather than in code: the closing speed of the Red raid in
Atacama Air Defense. The scenario authors every raider at 55 m/s on a fixed heading,
about 8.6 km out from a defended cluster, and a 1200-frame run is 60 s - so the speed
decides how far the raid gets inside the window, and whether the defences engage.
Which axis is OQ-4, and it is decided; the measurement that decided it is docs/m5-oq4.md.
The range stops at 220 on purpose. The platform honours an injected speed exactly up to
400 m/s and clamps above it, walking the entity down at 20 m/s^2 - so a value above 400
is not the value that flies, and a sweep that crossed it would plot a result against a
number that stopped being true partway through the run. Measured, m5-oq4.md section 3.
The gate runs at 55 - the scenario's own authored speed, and one of the values swept. It
establishes determinism FOR THAT VALUE. Six pairs at one value were compared while
